description: Product Name: Power BI Baidu ECharts Advanced Label Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: November 29, 2024 Developer: [Infortime Shiqin] Main functions: Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive label visualization objects through Power BI's data model to achieve dynamic data display. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including label placement, font style, color, and size, to meet the display needs of different users. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as mouse hovering and clicking, enhancing user experience. Responsive design: Label visualization objects can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Usage scenario: Key indicator display: Highlight key performance indicators (KPIs) in the dashboard. Data point annotation: Directly annotate important data points in the chart, such as sales revenue, growth rate, etc. Comparative analysis: When comparing different datasets, use labels to emphasize differences. User feedback: Use tags to display user satisfaction or opinions in user surveys or feedback collections. This visualization object aims to provide Power BI users with an innovative and feature rich way of presenting data, helping them better understand and analyze data.
